pages.text: The chamber uses entropy only for recipes. It has an item pipeline (1 slot, 1 fluid output tank) and a fluid pipeline (2 input tanks, 1 output tank).

Entropy fluid: 1 entropy shard gives 1,000 mB (0 entropy).$(br)Organa fluid: 4 Organa fruit give 1,000 mB (20 entropy).$(br)Ichor: 1,000 mB lava + 1,000 mB Organa fluid give 1,000 mB Ichor (100 entropy).
